fusions.name: Tramping Round
fusions.desc: Stamps down in a ring, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking each back 2 tiles. You restore 8 health. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

fusions.name: Last Mile
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. A lunging strike on a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 9 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at the end of its reach, and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Roadside Rest
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds and 14 health to you. Your movement speed rises 20% for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Provisioned Stride
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 8%. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.
